values.hero.intro.text_1: Web design, landing pages and custom web apps for businesses in Gladstone and Central Queensland. Built around the people using them.
values.hero.subline.text_1: Work with the app, not for it.
values.work.intro.text_1: From the first enquiry to the everyday work behind it. A closer look at the kinds of systems Phase Shift can help shape.
values.work.disclosure.text_1: A note on the work: the studio website and enquiry integration are from the supplied project. Other interfaces are illustrative concepts, awaiting genuine project screenshots and details.
values.services.intro.text_1: A first website, a better internal tool or a whole new workflow. Start with the part that makes a difference.
values.services.philosophy.text_1: Software and websites should fit the way people actually work.
values.pricing.intro.text_1: Know where you stand from the start. Choose a monthly website plan or an upfront build.
values.pricing.app_note.text_1: App builds are individually quoted. Monthly support is optional; hosting or third-party services may require recurring fees. New features can be quoted separately.
values.pricing.plugin_note.text_1: Add-on or plugin services may still require monthly billing.
values.pricing.tax_note.text_1: Pricing is in AUD and inclusive of GST where applicable.
values.promotion.eyebrow.text_1: A LITTLE HELP TO GET STARTED
values.promotion.description.text_1: To help support locals. Separate from the $0 creation fee monthly plan; eligible services and how offers apply are to be confirmed.
values.process.intro.text_1: You bring the problem. We work out what’s worth building, together. No obligation to go beyond the quote.
values.founder.introduction.text_1: I’m Jesse Freese, the person behind Phase Shift Studio in Gladstone, Queensland. You work directly with the person designing and building your project.
values.founder.philosophy.text_1: Phase Shift grew from first-hand experience with frustrating apps and systems that created extra work. My approach is simple: understand the real process, remove unnecessary steps and build only what is useful.
values.founder.quote.text_1: Efficiency is not the result of addition.
values.community.introduction.text_1: Useful digital tools should also be accessible to the organisations supporting our local community.
values.community.description.text_1: Community and charity organisations in Gladstone and Central Queensland are invited to discuss potential sponsored websites, workflow tools and other project support.
values.community.availability.text_1: Sponsorship is considered based on project fit and availability.
values.community.future.text_1: Future supported-project stories will be shared here, with permission.
values.contact.intro.text_1: A website that opens doors. A tool that takes a few steps out of your day. Tell me what you have in mind.
values.work.project_1.problem.text_1: Scattered job details and manual handovers make transport harder to coordinate.
values.work.project_1.solution.text_1: A transport dispatch platform for planning runs, assigning drivers, tracking deliveries and keeping job records together.
values.services.service_1.description.text_1: Business websites and landing pages for Gladstone businesses, with a clear message and a simple path to enquire.
values.services.service_1.feature_3.text_1: Clear navigation + practical sales and marketing consultation
values.process.step_1.description.text_1: Tell me what you are trying to build, improve or simplify. A rough idea is enough.
values.work.project_2.problem.text_1: An enquiry should be the start of a clear process, without entering the same details twice.
values.work.project_2.solution.text_1: The supplied site connects enquiries to an admin draft and email delivery. The illustration explores the wider quote journey.
values.services.service_2.description.text_1: Custom web app development for Gladstone and Central Queensland businesses: quoting systems, dashboards and customer portals built around your workflow.
values.process.step_2.description.text_1: Discuss the real workflow, identify what is worth building and receive a clear, no-obligation quote.
values.work.project_3.problem.text_1: Awkward spreadsheets make equipment details harder to find and keep consistent.
values.work.project_3.solution.text_1: An illustrative register for browsing equipment, checking specifications and keeping fleet information together.
values.services.service_3.description.text_1: Workflow tools and business automation for Gladstone teams. Replace awkward spreadsheets, reduce repeated administration and connect the steps between jobs.
values.process.step_3.description.text_1: Once the quote is accepted and the deposit is paid, design and build around the agreed workflow.
values.work.project_4.problem.text_1: Visitors need to understand the business and know how to take the next step.
values.work.project_4.solution.text_1: Phase Shift Studio’s own website combines clear services, public pricing and a direct enquiry flow.
values.services.service_4.description.text_1: Launch the useful version first, with a clear path to support and expansion as your business needs change.
values.process.step_4.description.text_1: Launch the first useful version, add support if needed and expand later when additional features earn their place.
values.pricing.landing.faq_answer.text_1: One clear page. One clear action.
values.pricing.landing.faq_answer.text_2: For a focused offer, campaign or a first business presence.
values.pricing.website.faq_answer.text_1: Room to explain. Built to convert.
values.pricing.website.faq_answer.text_2: For businesses with multiple services and a story that needs more room.
values.pricing.app.faq_answer.text_2: For quoting, operations, customer portals, fleet registers and internal systems.
values.pricing.monthly.description: Lower upfront cost. Support + updates included.
values.pricing.monthly.note: Monthly website plans include support, hosting and smaller improvements.
values.pricing.onetime.description: Pay once. Own the finished build.
values.pricing.onetime.note: Every project is quoted around the work that is actually useful. Ongoing website support can be discussed separately.
values.pricing.editor_portal.description.text_1: For $29.99 per month, access your own private edit portal and publish approved text and price updates from your phone or desktop. No coding, GitHub edits or redeployment required.
values.pricing.editor_portal.availability.text_: Available for compatible Phase Shift-managed websites.
values.pricing.editor_portal.feature_3.text_1: Update text and prices, then publish instantly
